newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch DSM posts 13 pct higher first-half profits.
newsitem.headline: Dutch DSM posts 13 pct higher first-half profits.

text.p: Dutch chemicals groups DSM NV on Wednesday reported a 13 percent jump in 1997 first-half net profits to 465 million guilders ($224.5 million) due to higher selling prices in the period.
Turnover increased 18 percent year-on-year to 6.12 billion guilders from 5.19 billion. The company announced an interim dividend of three guilders against 2.65 in the 1996 first half.
Shares in the chemicals group slipped back on the Amsterdam bourse, standing seven guilders down at 223.00 by 0805 GMT.
But the company said it saw "clearly higher" earnings for the year ahead.
"Favourable market circumstances and the expansion of our activities have resulted in strong sales growth," DSM director Loek Ligthart said in a statement.
